ValidationRule.description: Prevents the status from being changed to “In Prequalification” if mandatory lead information is missing. Requires Company, Salutation, First Name, Last Name, Email, and at least one phone number (Phone or Mobile).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(SkipValidation__c), ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Prequalification"), OR( ISBLANK(Company), ISPICKVAL(Salutation, ""), ISBLANK(FirstName), ISBLANK(LastName), ISBLANK(Email), AND( ISBLANK(Phone), ISBLANK(MobilePhone) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete all mandatory fields (Company, Salutation, First Name, Last Name, Email, and at least one phone number) before moving the lead to “In Prequalification”.
